output.title: Issuer kubectl short name improves operator convenience
output.content: This change adds the `iss` short name for Issuer resources, a kubectl convenience feature. The environment uses cert-manager with cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate resources installed. Operators managing this cert-manager deployment will benefit from the shorter kubectl syntax when working with Issuer resources. This is a non-breaking convenience enhancement that plausibly applies to operators administering cert-manager in this environment.
